title: Harness identity
description: v0.1 (2026-11-12, spike S4; shape accepted by the owner the same day). Field names may still change before H1 freezes them. One principal the Core can launch or serve: the operator, an agent, a sub-agent, a service or an MCP server. Field names follow the org's agent-inventory v0.1 format where it has one (id, kind, displayName, owner, status, createdAt, lastUsedAt, grants). Secret values never appear here.

owner.description: The accountable identity id. Every identity but the operator has one.

parent.description: For a sub-agent: the identity that may start it.

backend.description: Adapter manifest that launches it, e.g. 'codex', 'claude-code'. Null for the operator and for MCP servers.

status.description: Lifecycle. Only 'active' can start a session; 'retired' is final.

containment.description: The rung this identity runs on. 'unconfined' is shown as such everywhere it appears.

reviewedAt.description: When the operator last marked it reviewed (identity.review). Null until then.

reviewBy.description: When its next review is due.

grant.description: One permission. Anything not granted is denied. The Core compiles file and network grants to container policy at launch and checks the rest at the gateway.

effect.description: 'ask' raises an approval card; an unattended run treats it as deny. 'deny' beats every allow and ask, however narrow (added 2026-11-12 for the precedence rule).
